content: Railway: no-card-required Trial gives one-time $5 credit expiring in 30 days with generous limits (2 vCPU/1GB RAM/5 projects); does not scale-to-zero like Render (stays running while credit lasts); ongoing Free plan after trial is much tighter ($1/mo non-rollover credit, 0.5GB RAM) - insufficient long-term but fine to cover a 2-day hackathon deploy window.
